title: TrackMan PGA Tour averages 2024
source: TrackMan's own table of the PGA Tour 2024 averages (screenshot from the user, docs/ball-flight-reference-report.md section 0). Inputs as in arcade-swing-engine.js CLUB_PROFILES, targets as in the report's table.
note: Tour averages: the average of the launch values next to the average carry. The carry of the average shot is not the average carry (flight is not linear), so a few yards of the difference may be the comparison and not the physics. Only the rows whose inputs are in the repo are here; the 3 wood, 5 wood, hybrid, 3, 4, 6 and 8 iron rows need their ball speed, launch and spin from the table before they can be added.
